# Standalone original nominal Meaning

The selected function applies a non-self-adjoint phase through
`adjoint(checked_op(...))`, between Hadamard operations. Its explicit
Meaning uses an enum as an ordinary intermediate. The project adds a
closed caller that starts at zero and measures the result.

The first selected source requires independent closure checking. A
subsequent check succeeds on the same source. The first project check
exposes a pending queue position from the other original root. After
the native scope check binds the relevant invocation, the unchanged
project checks and gives the expected Born probabilities.
